user.title: SR655 Fan Control
user.description: Home Assistant tells the NAS-side fan controller whether to run its quiet or normal profile. Install and start the NAS-side package first; the topic prefix must match the topics in its config.json.

data.name: Name
data.away_delay: Quiet for this long after the last person leaves

data_description.topic_prefix: Publishes to <prefix>/profile/set and listens on <prefix>/profile, /availability and /telemetry.
data_description.presence_entity: Quiet while this entity is on or home; normal once it has been off or away for the delay below.
data_description.away_delay: Minutes. Use 0 to switch to normal as soon as everyone has left.
data_description.heartbeat_interval: Seconds. The profile is re-sent this often. The NAS falls back to normal after 120 s without a request, so keep this well below that.

error.invalid_topic: The topic prefix must not be empty or contain spaces, #, + or $.
